title: Consecutive-aborts loop-control state
description: State machine backing the autopilot anti-thrash guard. count increments on each [!] task abort and resets to 0 on the first [x] progress; a PIVOT fires on the 2nd consecutive abort of the same task; the loop hard-stops when count reaches 3.

count.description: Consecutive aborts since the last progress.

same_task_streak.description: Consecutive aborts of the same task id; resets when the task changes or on progress. A PIVOT fires when this reaches 2.

last_task.description: Task id of the most recently recorded event (e.g. T-014), or null when fresh.

last_error_hash.description: Hash of the last abort's error signature, used to detect repeated identical failures.

last_pivot_attempt.description: count value at which the most recent PIVOT was triggered; 0 if none.

updated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last state mutation.
